name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: By the sun and its brightness

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And [by] the moon when it follows it

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And [by] the day when it displays it

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And [by] the night when it covers it

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: He has succeeded who purifies it

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: When the most wretched of them was sent forth

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]

name: Ash-Shams · الشمس
en: And He does not fear the consequence thereof

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: By the night when it covers

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: And [by] the day when it appears

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: And [by] He who created the male and female

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: Indeed, your efforts are diverse

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: As for he who gives and fears Allah

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: And believes in the best [reward]

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: We will ease him toward ease

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: And denies the best [reward]

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: We will ease him toward difficulty

name: Al-Layl · الليل
ar: وَمَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
en: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]

name: Al-Layl · الليل
en: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing
